title: Meghadūta
author: Kālidāsa
note: Verse numbers follow the Digital Corpus of Sanskrit, counted separately in each part.

title: Mahābhārata
author: Vyāsa (critical edition)
note: So far the Nalopākhyāna (Āraṇyakaparvan, adhyāyas 50–78), with more of the epic to follow. Numbering follows the critical edition.

title: Kumārasaṃbhava
author: Kālidāsa
note: Sargas 1–8, the part of the poem generally held to be Kālidāsa's. Verse numbers follow the Digital Corpus of Sanskrit.

title: Ṛtusaṃhāra
author: attributed to Kālidāsa
note: One sarga for each of the six seasons. Verse numbers follow the Digital Corpus of Sanskrit.

title: Rāmāyaṇa
author: Vālmīki
note: The critical edition, added one kāṇḍa at a time. So far: Bālakāṇḍa, Ayodhyākāṇḍa, Araṇyakāṇḍa, Kiṣkindhākāṇḍa, Sundarakāṇḍa, Yuddhakāṇḍa, Uttarakāṇḍa. Numbering follows the critical edition, as annotated in the Digital Corpus of Sanskrit.

title: Kaṭhopaniṣad
note: Cited as adhyāya.vallī.verse. Vedic forms are common, and Pāṇini's rules as implemented cover them less fully than classical Sanskrit.

title: Aṣṭāvakragītā
note: Janaka asks, Aṣṭāvakra teaches. Verse numbers follow the Digital Corpus of Sanskrit.
